top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §746.501(a)(17))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the inspection,  the operational policy reviewed did not include information informing parents about the operation having a dog present at the center.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity plan did not include outdoor play.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Volunteers and contractors not counted in the child/caregiver ratio must comply with minimum standards that apply to employees (26 TAC §746.1401(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. The operation had 14-year-old individuals interacting with the enrolled children in a caregiver capacity.
